answer: Continuous Physical Presence Ledger. Each identity must periodically solve a challenge tied to a unique, geolocated hardware beacon whose location is hidden and rotated by the verifier—say one near a glacier, another by a lagoon. The agent must photograph the beacon beside a freshly issued lantern-lit code and submit within a tight window. A single operator can host many software instances but cannot occupy many distant physical sites at once, so each sustained identity demands separate hardware, travel, and a distinct human presence—costs that scale linearly and make mass fakery impractical.
